facts.text: Undergraduate students at Baylor University must complete two semesters of Chapel as a requirement for graduation.

sources.title: Your Chapel Requirement | Spiritual Life | Baylor University
sources.quote: Undergraduate Baylor students are required to receive two chapel credits in order to graduate. Students must take two semesters of chapel and you may not take two chapels in the same semester.
